subject: science
concept: Understanding biodiversity's role in ecosystem resilience and stability
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Ecosystem Dynamics) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a physical model of a diverse ecosystem to a simplified low-diversity one and predicts resilience to disruption
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an ecosystem's biodiversity level to its predicted ability to recover from disturbance
exercise.abstract: Student explains why higher biodiversity generally improves an ecosystem's resilience

misconception_flags: assumes biodiversity has no meaningful effect on how an ecosystem responds to disturbance

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
